title: Fixed Binaural Tubes and Disc Stethoscope
description: One newly authored complete fixed stethoscope visual prop laid in a gentle planar display pose. Two distinct bent metal-looking binaural tubes end in separate closed soft eartips, with no visor, headband or earcup shells. Two full flexible branch tubes meet a finite central connector and one continuous long curved tube that terminates in a short chestpiece neck. A complete stepped circular chestpiece carries a separate opaque diaphragm-looking disc. All tube paths and whole components are original numeric geometry. One prop, zero scenes, three opaque materials. Fixed stylized medical-profession appearance only: no patient, sound propagation, diagnosis, disease, use instructions, calibration, medical-device performance, hygiene or safety claim.
